subject: Renewal pricing + capacity add — SmartLayer
messages:
From: Eva Crawford <eva.crawford@smartlayer.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@smartlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal conversation — pricing and capacity add

Hi Rafael,

Hope you had a good weekend. Our renewal with Redwood is coming up (Mar 31) and our execs want to align on pricing if we commit to an additional 30% capacity for the coming year. We have improved product throughput and expect higher token consumption; procurement needs a one-page summary of options (price hold, credits, or tiered discount) by EOD Friday to present to finance.

Can you share what flexibility you have on price holds and short-term credits if we increase committed capacity? Also copying Ben from procurement — he can share the PO timing.

Thanks,
Eva

Eva Crawford
Head of Platform Ops | SmartLayer Inc.
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Eva Crawford <eva.crawford@smartlayer.com>
Cc: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@smartlayer.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Feb 2028 10:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — pricing and capacity add

Eva — thanks for the heads up and the context. We can definitely structure a renewal that includes a temporary price hold and a staged discount for an uplift in committed capacity. To get a sharp proposal, can you send the last 3 months of token usage by model (or I can accept the CSV from procurement)? Also: is the ask for a hard price hold for 12 months or a time-limited commitment (6 months + review)?

I'll put together two options: (A) 12-month price hold + modest up-front credit tied to the 30% uplift, (B) 6-month price hold + larger credits and a performance-based true-up. If you can confirm expected contract start and PO cadence I will include DocuSign-ready term sheet.

—Rafael
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@smartlayer.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: Eva Crawford <eva.crawford@smartlayer.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 08:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — pricing and capacity add

Rafael — attaching high-level usage export (usage_report_Q4.csv). We are targeting a 12-month effective price hold if possible; however finance will accept 6 months + a guaranteed floor if the delta to your list price is material.

PO timing: procurement expects to have an approved PO by Mar 15. Budget is tight — they’re asking for any credits to be recognized as a one-time credit in the first invoice.

Ben Ortiz
Senior Procurement Manager | SmartLayer Inc.
Attachment: usage_report_Q4.csv
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@smartlayer.com>, Eva Crawford <eva.crawford@smartlayer.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Feb 2028 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — pricing and capacity add

Ben — got the CSV, thanks. Looping in Laura from Finance and Sergio (CS/solutions) to confirm internal guardrails and operational impact.

High level proposal (will follow with a one-page PDF):
- Option 1: 12-month price hold at current committed effective rate + a one-time credit equal to 8% of annual committed spend applied to first invoice.
- Option 2: 6-month price hold + 14% one-time credit + guaranteed usage floor for Q3/Q4 to protect margins; true-up after 6 months.

We can also offer a phased uplift discount: first 6 months a 10% uplift credit on the incremental capacity, then revert to the committed rate. I will attach a draft term sheet and the impact worksheet.

Internal ask: can Finance accept the credit recognition as Ben requested (one-time first-invoice credit)? Laura — can you confirm from an accounting and margin perspective, and if we need to cap the credit dollar amount?

Rafael
Attachment: SmartLayer_Renewal_Draft.pdf
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
Cc: sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@smartlayer.com>, Eva Crawford <eva.crawford@smartlayer.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Feb 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal conversation — pricing and capacity add

Rafael / team — reviewed the numbers in the draft. We can accept a one-time credit recognized on the first invoice provided: (a) total credit is capped at $120k (to keep margin impact within the current quarter), and (b) the agreement includes a 12-month minimum commitment (if SmartLayer increases and then reduces within 90 days, we reserve the right to re-evaluate).

If Ben needs the credit described as a rebate versus a contra-invoice, we can accommodate the language but need procurement to confirm. Sergio — from an ops perspective, will the KV cache/throughput profile change materially with the uplift? If so, we may need a brief onboarding cadence.

Laura Bennett
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>
To: Eva Crawford <eva.crawford@smartlayer.com>, Ben Ortiz <ben.ortiz@smartlayer.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, sergio_alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 28 Feb 2028 16:04:00 -0800
Subject: Revised term sheet and next steps — SmartLayer renewal

Eva / Ben — thanks for the patience. Attached is the revised one-page term sheet (redwood_term_sheet_v3.pdf) that reflects:
- 12-month price hold at the current effective rate
- One-time credit = lesser of 8% of committed annual spend or $120k, applied as a contra-invoice on the first invoice
- Phased uplift: incremental capacity up to +30% receives a 10% credit on incremental usage for the first 6 months
- PO target: Mar 15; Contract effective Apr 1.

If this aligns I will send the DocuSign link for signatures. Ben — confirm that procurement is OK with the contra-invoice treatment; if not we will change language to a rebate.

Next steps:
1) Procurement confirms credit recognition wording (contra-invoice vs. rebate) — Ben
2) SmartLayer legal confirms term sheet — Eva
3) I send DocuSign (targeting Mar 1) — Rafael

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abc-123

Thanks — Rafael
Attachment: redwood_term_sheet_v3.pdf
